Two key advantages of white-box access over black-box access for AI audits are:

1. White-box access allows auditors to perform stronger attacks and more thoroughly interpret models, which helps in identifying weaknesses and understanding the internal mechanisms responsible for undesirable behaviors.

2. White-box access enables fine-tuning, which can reveal harmful dormant capabilities and allows for more targeted evaluations and risk assessments based on the internal workings of the AI system.
